thread:
alex: Quick standup in 10 to sync postmortem actions for alert tuning (noise reduction, thresholds, dedupe). PM: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/pm-2026-04-spotty-alerts

alex: Agenda: owners & deadlines, blockers, confirm suppression rules + verification plan.

maria: Can you paste the current action list? I'll triage ownership in the doc.

alex: Pasting action list from the PM:
- A1: tighten error-rate threshold on svc-ingest (owner: maria) — due 2026-05-02
- A2: dedupe rule for kafka-lag alerts (owner: sam) — due 2026-04-28
- A3: add quiet-window policy for batch-jobs (owner: jordan) — due 2026-05-05
- A4: rollout probabilistic dedupe experiment (owner: lina) — due 2026-05-12

sam: Ack. Need clarification on alert fingerprinting — current rule matches on topic+partition, too noisy.

alex: Sam, propose grouping by consumer-group instead. Example snippet: 
```
fingerprint_fields: ["consumer_group"]
dedupe_ttl: 300s
```

jordan: Quiet-window — ops asked for 02:00-05:00 UTC for nightly backfills, is that okay?

lina: Experiment plan: staging canary -> 10% traffic for 48h. Monitor p95 latency and false-positive rate; automatic rollback on FP spike.

maria: Blocker: svc-ingest threshold changes need infra support for a test deploy. @ops-bot can you schedule a canary window?

ops-bot: @maria scheduled staging canary for 2026-04-26 02:00-04:00 UTC. Runbook updated: https://playbooks.redwood/runbooks/alert-tuning

sam: I'll implement the dedupe rule and open a PR by EOD tomorrow, request review from eng-oncall.

alex: Owners confirmed: maria, sam, jordan, lina. I'll own tracking and create JIRA tickets, link back to PM doc.

jordan: Add rollback criteria: paging rate increase >20% OR ingest error-rate +2x triggers immediate rollback.

alex: Added to doc.

maria: Who owns post-deploy verification? I can run first-week checks (pager cadence, sample traces).

lina: I'll wire dashboards: dedupe hit-rate, pagers avoided, and false-positive trend.

alex: Great. Next follow-up standup Friday 14:00 UTC. Please post short updates as threads under the PM doc. :thumbsup:
